quest.title: House of the Soulless
quest.description: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

talks.objective: Talk to the Snegovik standing guard

dialogues.speaker: Snegovik of the Guard
dialogues.text: Uh, who are you...? But whoever you are, this place is off-limits to ordinary visitors. Please do not linger here either.

talks.objective: Look for another way to enter the room

dialogues.speaker: Snegovik of the Guard
dialogues.text: Uh, who are you...? But whoever you are, this place is off-limits to ordinary visitors. Please do not linger here either.

dialogues.speaker: Vase
dialogues.text: (The flowers in the vase... Though you already saw this earlier, another close look reveals signs of scraping on the floor around the vase.)

dialogues.speaker: Vase
dialogues.text: (You also spot what looks like cat scratches on the bottom of the vase. Could this be...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! The door's open! Now we can go farther in!

talks.objective: Solve the puzzle in the secret room

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: It should be somewhere nearby... That room appears to be off-limits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And it's guarded, too... Let's <color=#00E1FFFF>look for another way in</color> first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could the fragment be in there...? No, doesn't look like it. All Paimon can see are strange paintings and Prime Ice sculptures!

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That's strange. While I can sense the fragment is more or less around here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can't find it? Let's have a look around first then...
